meta_description: AP Plastering Ltd in Leeds offers professional internal and external plastering, rendering, and decoration. Fast, reliable service. Call 07563 819005 today.
hero_eyebrow: Skilled Plasterer — Fast Turnaround, Local Expertise
hero_subhead: From cracked ceilings to full room renovations, we deliver smooth, professional finishes across Leeds and Bramley.
services_subhead: Whether it's interior finishing, external rendering, or specialist repairs, we handle every plastering job with precision and care.

services.title: Internal Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Ceiling and wall plastering, artex removal, and smooth skimming finishes. We leave surfaces ready for paint or wallpaper, creating a professional look throughout your home.

services.title: External Rendering & Roughcast
services.desc: Durable exterior render and roughcast application to protect your property and boost kerb appeal. Built to withstand Leeds weather with quality materials and expert technique.

services.title: Crack Repair & Patch Work
services.desc: Expert diagnosis and repair of plasterboard damage, cracks, and settlement issues. We make repairs invisible, blending seamlessly with existing finishes.

services.title: Coving & Cornice Installation
services.desc: Precision installation of decorative coving and cornice work to add elegance to any room. Finished and painted to a professional standard.

services.title: Damp-Proof Plaster & Tanking
services.desc: Specialist moisture-resistant plaster for basements and problem walls. We tackle damp before it spreads, protecting your property long-term.

services.title: Commercial & New Build Work
services.desc: Large-scale plastering for commercial projects, new builds, and renovations. Reliable scheduling, consistent quality, and minimal disruption to your site.

about_pullquote: I took over this business because I believe in doing the job right, not the quick way.
about_para_1: AP Plastering Ltd has been serving Leeds and Bramley for over a decade. What started as a one-person operation has grown into a trusted local business, built on solid craftsmanship and honest pricing. Every project — whether a small patch or a full house renovation — receives the same level of attention and skill.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we finish on time, communicate clearly, and take pride in leaving spaces that look perfect. We're not the cheapest, but we're fast, reliable, and we clean up after ourselves. That's earned us a strong reputation across Leeds, and word-of-mouth remains our best source of work.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About AP Plastering

reviews.text: Had the whole upstairs skimmed after removing old artex. Dusty job but they managed the mess brilliantly. Finish is flawless — painter said it was the best prep he'd seen in years. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Quote was fair, work started on time and finished when they said. New rendering on the front of the house looks smart. Not the cheapest but you get what you pay for. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Karen M.

reviews.text: Cracked ceiling repair that could've been a nightmare. They sorted it in half a day and you can't tell where the damage was. Professional lads, tidy, and honest about costs. Top service.
reviews.author: David P.
